english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that someone is not allowed to do something or enter somewhere.
Use this as the all-purpose way to say that rules do not permit an action or participation.
Use this as the all-purpose spoken way to say that someone is not allowed to do something.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for forbidding someone from doing something, including by a rule or law.
